fields.notes: NVMe Base 1.4 has no formal scan / DFT architecture at the bus interface. Device Self-Test + Get Log Page + AER are the only protocol-level observability mechanisms. Internal NAND/SCM test is vendor-specific.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Polling.Compliance pattern
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: LTSSM sub-state that transmits a defined compliance pattern at 2.5 GT/s for electrical eye / BER characterization.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Loopback test mode
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Loopback Master transmits a known pattern; Loopback Slave retransmits it back; allows receiver-eye and serializer/deserializer testing without a full link partner.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Hot Reset
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: TS1 with Hot Reset bit set forces downstream device to Detect; testable via Bridge Control Secondary Bus Reset.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Disable Link
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Forces TX into Electrical Idle for power-consumption and OFF-state characterization.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Compliance Pattern (Section 4.2.8)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Spec-defined repeating pattern of K28.5 + D21.5 + K28.5 + D10.2 for electrical eye / jitter measurement.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Advanced Error Reporting (AER)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Provides in-protocol observability of correctable / uncorrectable / fatal errors.

internal_diagnostics_observability: Link Status Register — current LTSSM state, negotiated Link Speed + Link Width.
Slot Status Register — Card Present, Power Indicator, Attention Indicator, MRL Sensor, Power Fault.
Device Status Register — Correctable / Non-Fatal / Fatal Error Detected, Unsupported Request Detected, AUX Power Detected, Transactions Pending.
Root Status Register — PME Status, PME Pending, PME Requester ID.
AER Uncorrectable Error Status / Mask / Severity Registers — fine-grained protocol-error observability.
AER Header Log Register — first 4 DW of the offending TLP header preserved for postmortem.
VC Resource Status Register — per-VC negotiation status.
out_of_band_test_facilities: PROBE-via-protocol-analyzer (LeCroy / Keysight / vendor-specific) — interposer or mid-board tap to capture TLPs / DLLPs / Ordered Sets.
PROBE-via-vendor-PHY-debug-port — implementation-defined (PIPE-style PHY interface specs add scan + debug; not in Base Spec).

exposed_dft_features.name: Device Self-Test (Admin OPC=14h)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Short or Extended self-test of controller + namespaces.

exposed_dft_features.name: Get Log Page
exposed_dft_features.purpose: SMART/Health, Error Information, Firmware Slot, Telemetry, Persistent Event, ANA, etc.

exposed_dft_features.name: PCIe AER Capability
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Link-layer error observability via PCI Config Space.

fields.no_jtag_on_form_factor_connector: NVMe Base 1.4 does NOT define JTAG / scan / boundary-scan signals on M.2 / U.2 / EDSFF connectors. Vendor silicon debug is via wafer-probe or package-level JTAG, hidden from host.

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
